msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Use the EXACT garment(s) and accessories from the reference image: identical cut, length, fabric, colour, print, buttons, trims and details. Do not redesign, recolour or add garments. Show the clothes on a professional female fashion model (a woman). If the reference is a mirror selfie, the new photo has no phone, no mirror and no selfie pose. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. REGLA B: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia mantones-africa-54.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): A stylish Spanish woman in her thirties wearing a royal blue silk manila shawl richly embroidered with red and pink flowers and a long blue fringe, worn over a white flamenco dress with navy polka dots from the reference, walking at the Real de la Feria de Abril in Seville, Spain, with striped casetas and paper lanterns, golden hour. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen, diptych, panel or collage. The subject stands in the right third of the frame and the same scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Wide editorial campaign image, cinematic natural light. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia mantones-africa-12.jpg, aplica la REGLA B): E-commerce product photo of a sage green silk manila scarf embroidered with pink and coral flowers and a long magenta fringe, folded into a triangle from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#ECE7E0) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia mantones-africa-26.jpg, aplica la REGLA B): E-commerce product photo of a cream silk manila scarf embroidered with multicoloured flowers and a long mauve fringe, folded into a triangle from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#ECE7E0) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia mantones-africa-42.jpg, aplica la REGLA B): E-commerce product photo of a navy blue silk manila scarf embroidered with red roses, blue birds and colourful flowers from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#ECE7E0) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia mantones-africa-43.jpg, aplica la REGLA B): E-commerce product photo of a white silk manila scarf embroidered in black with large flowers from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#ECE7E0) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail.
